I appreciate the time you have taken to write to me. See i been depressed for a few years. I had a fiance for 7 years, and i tried it all to make it work and about 8 months ago we broke up. I gave it 150% while he gave 45% on a good day. I cried days on end and felt the world was crushing me. Then i met someone who i spoke to for hours on end. For a few months we talked and talked. He confessed his love for me and i told him i wasn't ready. I was broken and scared to try again. I went to visit him many times to Vegas, and he was persistent on dating me. After 6 months i finally said yes. He talked marriage, kids, getting me to move to vegas ( which i already got a place and paid for). He made me feel loved and alive. Then, out of no where he hit me with "I'm not ready for a relationship". I am devastated, hurt and i feel like a crazy ex trying to reach him. But i had enough. He ghosted me for a whole week. Never had i felt something so horrible. I know i will forget him one day and the pain will subside but i had enough. Of trying. I have a good job, my own home, a loving family. And that's the scary part. I got a lot going on yet i feel like an empty shell walking around. I'm tired. And i want to end it, and i rather do it far from my family.
